meta.name: migrate
meta.description: Migrate from Cypress or Selenium to Playwright. Use when user mentions "cypress", "selenium", "migrate tests", "convert tests", "switch to playwright", "move from cypress", or "replace selenium".

copy.tagline: 将 Cypress 或 Selenium 测试迁移到 Playwright
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 Cypress 或 Selenium 转向 Playwright
copy.tagline_en: Migrate Cypress or Selenium tests to Playwright
copy.fit_line_en: For you if migrating from Cypress or Selenium to Playwright

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把 Cypress 或 Selenium 的测试文件逐个转换成 Playwright 代码，并自动升级选择器、处理自定义命令，最后验证转换结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“Cypress”、“Selenium”、“迁移测试”、“转换测试”、“改用 Playwright”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Cypress 测试文件转成 Playwright。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并逐行转换。

say.text: 迁移我的 Selenium 测试套件到 Playwright。
say.note: Claude 会扫描项目并开始批量转换。

say.text: 把 cypress/e2e 目录下的所有测试转成 Playwright。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you convert Cypress or Selenium test files to Playwright one by one, automatically upgrade selectors, handle custom commands, and verify the converted results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "cypress", "selenium", "migrate tests", "convert tests", "switch to playwright", "move from cypress", or "replace selenium".

say_en.text: Convert this Cypress test file to Playwright.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and convert it line by line.

say_en.text: Migrate my Selenium test suite to Playwright.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the project and start batch conversion.

say_en.text: Convert all tests in the cypress/e2e directory to Playwright.
say_en.note: Claude will convert the entire directory.
